item.title: Nearly 800 people walk across Bob Michel Bridge for Pathway Ministries fundraiser
item.description: Pathway Ministries' first ever "Walk a Mile in My Shoes" event saw nearly 800 people participate in a one-mile walk to raise awareness and support for people experiencing homelessness, abuse and addiction in the Peoria area, raising close to 100 thousand dollars for shelter programs and renewal services.

item.title: Peoria Polar Plunge raises more than $40,000 for Special Olympics Illinois
item.description: The Law Enforcement Torch Run Polar Plunge in Peoria raised over $40,000 for Special Olympics Illinois, with over 80 participants taking an icy plunge to support the organization's mission of inclusion and providing sports training and competitions for athletes with intellectual disabilities.

item.title: Three arrested for stealing cars linked a deadly tow-yard crash last summer
item.description: Three people have been arrested in connection with a stolen car that was linked to a deadly incident in South Peoria last summer, resulting in the death of 70-year-old William Collier.

item.title: Galesburg house fire claims lives of person and dog
item.description: A person and a dog were killed in a house fire in Galesburg, Illinois, on Saturday morning, and two firefighters were injured while trying to rescue them.

item.title: Bradley gets revenge on ISU 74-60, splits season series for 2nd straight year
item.description: The Bradley Braves defeated the Illinois State Redbirds 74-60 in front of a sold-out Carver Arena, with Jaquan Johnson leading the way with 23 points and a couple of late steals to secure the win.

item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: No miracle needed. The United States is on top of the hockey world for the first time in nearly a half-century.

item.title: Engineering Day draws large crowd to Peoria Riverfront Museum
item.description: The Peoria Riverfront Museum's annual Engineering Day brought together local engineering firms, robotics teams, and community organizations to provide hands-on activities and inspire future innovators.

item.title: Two events at Northwoods Mall generate heavy foot traffic Sunday
item.description: The Peoria Flea Market and Quad Con Comic and Toy Show were held at Northwoods Mall on the same day, creating a lively atmosphere and boosting business for vendors and the mall.

item.title: Jack in the Box Office: A potential shake-up at No. 1 this weekend
item.description: "Goat" from Sony Pictures Animation is projected to jump to the top of the box office in its second weekend, potentially surpassing last weekend's champ "Wuthering Heights", while "I Can Only Imagine 2" is forecasted to open between $10 and $15 million.

item.title: Peoria Co-Responder Unit: How's it fairing after more than a year?
item.description: The Peoria Police Department and Carle Health's Trillium Place have partnered to create a co-responder unit that has responded to over 250 calls and served over 130 clients in its first year, providing mental health support and resources to those in need.
